The '''Berchestian Civil Service''' was a [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucratic]] organization on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Berchest/Legends|Berchest]]. [[Fingal]] worked for the Berchestian Civil Service and wore their uniform while on duty.
